Don't leave the pan on the stove, MiaHow to make it4 rashers of streaky bacon120g popcorn kernels2 tbsp vegetable oil60g butter2 tbsp maple syrup1 pinch flaky sea saltFry the bacon until very crisp, then crumble.Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat, add the kernels, cover and shake constantly until the popping slows. Pull it off straight away.Cook the butter in a small pan until golden brown and nutty, then stir in the maple syrup.Pour over the popcorn and toss with the bacon and a good pinch of salt.1967 cocktail party bitesDevilled eggs, grape jelly glazed cocktail franks, celery filled with cream cheeseHow to make it6 eggs3 tbsp mayonnaise1 tsp paprika16 cocktail franks100ml barbecue sauce1 tbsp grape jelly3 celery sticks, cut into boats150g cream cheese8 olives, slicedBoil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and halve. Whip the yolks with the mayonnaise and paprika and pipe back in.Simmer the franks in the barbecue sauce and grape jelly until sticky.Fill the celery boats with cream cheese and sliced olives.Sewing one and lay on lined trays.Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and golden, then cool on a rack.MainsEvelyn's chicken and rice mushroom casseroleChicken thighs baked over creamy mushroom riceHow to
